verdict.rationale: The Snapdragon X2 Elite Extreme is a laptop processor (CPU, NPU and memory subsystem). Performing bulk operations across many items is a software or app workflow feature, so the story is a category error for silicon. Nothing in the evidence shows the chip itself ships such a capability; AI Hub tooling is about model deployment, not bulk item operations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
